title: Forbid mid-work continue-asks in the always-loaded instruction layer
action: Agents end turns mid-slice asking 'Say go'/'continue?' — the no-ask rule lives only in go-mode.md (loaded only under /go), so ordinary sessions never see it. Promote it to the always-loaded layer: (1) packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md, rule agents-one-next-action — after 'never a menu', add: when the next action is the agent's own move, the agent takes it in the same turn; between the merged gate and the uat stop, a finished slice with approved work remaining continues without asking — 'Say go' / 'continue?' is drift, not a stop. (2) skills/bee-swarming/SKILL.md Completion — 'slice done with more approved work remaining -> return to bee-planning for the next batch' gains 'in the same turn, never a user question'. Then bee dev regen inside this cell to sync AGENTS.md and mirrors (render-skill-trees, onboard --repo-root . --apply, release-manifest --write).

truths: AGENTS.block.md and generated AGENTS.md state the same-turn continuation rule inside agents-one-next-action
bee-swarming Completion says the next batch continues in the same turn, never as a user question
The two legitimate stops (plan gate, uat) are unchanged
bee dev regen green, mirrors in sync

verify: bee dev regen green; bee dev release-manifest --check clean; rg 'in the same turn' AGENTS.md skills/bee-swarming/SKILL.md packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md confirms the promoted rule in all three
